## 💬 Support Chatbot (Telegram)
KB-first answers (free, instant, deterministic) → LLM grounding for the rest → honest fallback.
`/start` `/faq` `/demo` `/human`. Edit the KB in "Load knowledge base".

### Fallback
LLM gets the FULL KB as grounding context.
If it fails/times out/garbles → honest "flagged for the team" template ships.
No hallucinated prices ever.
